about.en: Petroleo Brasileiro S.A. - Petrobras is Brazil's state-controlled integrated energy company, active in exploration and production, refining, logistics, gas, electricity, fertilizers and fuel and lubricant products. PBR represents its NYSE-listed American depositary shares on the common shares, each equal to two common shares listed in Sao Paulo as PETR3, and is distinct from the depositary shares on the preferred shares traded as PBR.A.
